title_or_table: S. 146, TAKE IT DOWN Act, 119th Congress, actions (Library of Congress summary actions)
universe_or_base: The actions the Library of Congress records as the bill's major steps
vintage: Congress.gov data as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: The bill passed the Senate by unanimous consent with no recorded vote, and the House 409 to 2 under a suspension of the rules, which needs two-thirds; it became Public Law 119-12 on May 19, 2025
printed_source_line: Source: Library of Congress, Congress.gov, S. 146, TAKE IT DOWN Act, actions, January 16 to May 19, 2025, United States Congress. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Passed the Senate by unanimous consent with no recorded vote; became Public Law 119-12.
domain_note: The law requires online platforms to remove nonconsensual intimate images, including computer-made fakes, within 48 hours of a valid request; V7 places platforms and fake media under news, records and public information (issue I010)
